note: Practical priors about bowfishing are hypotheses until validated on field data; fit-for-purpose targets are pre-declared requirements, not achievements.
role: Water level and level-change state of the reservoir
bowfishingPurpose: Level decides where fish can be reached: rising water floods shallow margins and vegetation where carp, buffalo and gar feed and spawn; falling or drawn-down water withdraws fish from the margins and exposes banks.
decisionsInformed: which shoreline and flats are fishable

predicts.desc: Current operator-reported pool elevation with age
Where the level sits relative to operator pool and its recent trend
Rising/falling stage as an access signal

mustNotPredict: flood-pool alerts without an operator threshold

providesTo.why: effective depth is level minus a datum
reservoir size modulates warming and cooling

fitForPurpose.metric: independent fresh level source per fleet lake
fitForPurpose.rationale: a level that is missing or stale makes every level-dependent output abstain

priorityQuestions: Which fleet lakes have no independent fresh level source?
How much does a rise of N feet per day change shallow-margin access?
